intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a resource leak in cc_mac_digest by adding missing cleanup for the result buffer when map_ahash_request_final fails.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to cc_unmap_result() within the error handling block immediately following a failure check of cc_map_hash_request_final().
